run_energy_analysis: run the energy.py script to parse MOF adsorption energy data and identify promising pristine and defective MOFs
review_adsorption_data_parsing: review the energy.py script that parses adsorption_energy.txt to extract MOF names, defect concentrations, and gas adsorption energies
refactor_lowest_energy_computation: refactor the energy.py script to use pandas groupby and idxmin instead of manual loops for finding lowest energy configurations
review_promising_mof_filtering: review the energy.py script that filters MOFs with CO2 adsorption energy below -0.5 eV and stronger than H2O adsorption
run_mof_adsorption_plotting: run the energy.py script to generate parity scatter plots comparing CO2 vs H2O adsorption energies for pristine and defective MOFs
